tasks.description: Design and implement a notification system that can handle various types of events. The system should be able to send notifications to users in a timely manner. The goal is to keep users informed without overwhelming them with too many notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has an account, when an important event occurs, then the user receives a notification within 5 minutes.

tasks.description: Identify and implement event triggers for important events such as account updates, new messages, or changes in account status. These triggers will be used to send notifications to users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event trigger is set up, when the event occurs, then the notification system is notified.

tasks.description: Design and create notification templates for different types of events. These templates should be customizable and allow for personalization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification template, when the template is used to send a notification, then the notification is formatted correctly and contains the expected information.

tasks.description: Implement a system to control the frequency of notifications sent to users. This system should prevent users from receiving too many notifications in a short period of time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has received a notification, when the user receives another notification within a short period of time, then the second notification is delayed or bundled with the first notification.

tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests for the notification system to ensure it is working correctly and as expected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification test, when the test is run, then the test passes and the notification system is verified to be working correctly.

tasks.summary: Migrate existing events to new system
tasks.description: Migrate existing events and triggers to the new notification system. This will ensure that all important events are handled by the new system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing event, when the event is migrated to the new system, then the event is handled correctly by the new system.

tasks.description: Identify and fix any bugs or issues with the notification system. This will ensure that the system is stable and working correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification bug, when the bug is fixed, then the notification system is working correctly and the bug is resolved.

tasks.description: Add user notification preferences to allow users to customize their notification settings. This will give users more control over the notifications they receive.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user updates their notification preferences, then the notification system respects the user's preferences.
